description: Record the approver's decision on a reviewed invoice: approved, rejected, or returned to the requester with a note. Approving re-runs the hard rules in code (duplicate, vendor mismatch, missing PO over the limit, closed PO, over tolerance, line sum) and refuses when any fails, needs a note when the review recommended escalate, and adds the total to the purchase order's billed-to-date. Returning needs a note and puts the invoice back to the requester for a resubmission. Every decision appends an event. Fired only from the operator-confirmed Approve / Return / Reject action via the direct-invoke lane; not listed in any agent's tools, so the model cannot call it.

invoice_id.description: The invoice to decide, e.g. inv_brightline_0417.

note.description: The approver's note, recorded with the decision. Required for returned, and for approved when the review recommended escalate.
